They may set up a new drilling operation or move already existing operation, which has proved successful, to the new site. The probability of success and expected returns are as follows:

content.value: If the Corporation do not bid or lose the contract, they can use the TK,600 million to modernize their operation. This would result in a return of either 5%, or 8% on the sum invested with probabilities 0.45 and 0.55 (Assume that all costs and revenue have been discounted to present value)
(i)Construct a decision tree for the problem showing clearly the course of action.
